title: Emergent Incompressibility in Polariton Condensates for Scalable XY Spin Simulation
abstract: Driven-dissipative polariton networks offer a powerful analog platform for simulating continuous-spin Hamiltonians. However, their practical scalability is fundamentally limited by amplitude-phase coupling and metastable trapping in highly frustrated energy landscapes. Here, we present an \textit{in situ} dual-enhancement mechanism to address these bottlenecks without requiring external site-specific fine-tuning. First, a renormalization-group analysis based on density rescaling shows that higher-order nonlinear loss drives the condensates toward an incompressible regime, intrinsically suppressing amplitude fluctuations and enforcing phase-only dynamics. For macroscopic XY networks (up to 10,000 spins), this phase-amplitude decoupling yields a more than 50-fold reduction in energy, while simultaneously shrinking the standard deviation by a factor of six. More generally, it restores the extensive scaling of the optimized XY energy with system size. Second, to navigate the rugged, nonconvex energy landscape, we introduce weak Hermitian pulses. When implemented through a multistage protocol, these pulses enable repeated escapes from local minima and drive the system to deeper energy minima. Benchmarking shows an increasing advantage with system size, with the polariton simulator outperforming the classical Monte Carlo-SQP baseline in every sampled macroscopic realization. Our work provides a physical framework for scalable polariton analog computing.
subjects: Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall) ; Adaptation and Self-Organizing Systems (nlin.AO); Quantum Physics (quant-ph)

summaries.en: A dual-enhancement mechanism combining higher-order nonlinear loss that drives polariton condensates into an incompressible phase-only regime and weak Hermitian pulses that escape metastable minima enables scalable XY spin simulation, reducing energy more than 50-fold for networks up to 10,000 spins and outperforming classical Monte Carlo-SQP baselines.

title: Neural Networks with Exciton-Polariton Waveguides
abstract: We propose and numerically study a scheme for neural networks using exciton-polariton waveguide meshes. These enable arbitrary programmable interlayer couplings suited to a restricted Boltzmann machine architecture where polariton phases act as stochastic network variables. We show that such a network can be trained using unsupervised Hebbian and anti-Hebbian updates. This allows the implementation of an associative memory, where the network recovers learned patterns from imperfect inputs.

summaries.en: The authors propose and numerically study a neural network based on exciton-polariton waveguide meshes that provide programmable interlayer couplings for a restricted Boltzmann machine in which polariton phases serve as stochastic variables and which can be trained with unsupervised Hebbian and anti-Hebbian updates to implement an associative memory that recovers learned patterns from imperfect inputs.

title: Spin Simulators based on Exciton-Polariton Waveguide Networks
abstract: Many NP-hard optimization problems can be mapped onto interacting spin systems, whose ground state encodes the optimal solution. Polaritonic implementations based on gain-dissipative dynamics have recently emerged as promising analog computing platforms owing to their intrinsic parallelism and ultrafast operation. However, existing approaches are hindered by two fundamental limitations: maintaining the homogeneous amplitudes required for faithful problem encoding remains challenging in realistic physical systems, and most architectures are restricted to nearest-neighbour interactions, severely limiting the variety of optimization problems that can be efficiently addressed. We introduce a feasible polaritonic XY simulator based on a reconfigurable waveguide platform that overcomes both limitations. Our approach guarantees amplitude homogeneity while enabling the implementa- tion of arbitrary symmetric coupling matrices, thereby allowing the direct encoding of a wide variety of XY Hamiltonians. These results establish a practical architecture for programmable polaritonic spin simulators and pave the way towards scalable optical hardware for analog optimisation.

summaries.en: The paper introduces a feasible polaritonic XY spin simulator built on a reconfigurable exciton-polariton waveguide network that guarantees amplitude homogeneity and enables arbitrary symmetric coupling matrices, overcoming the restrictions of previous gain-dissipative architectures to allow direct encoding of a wide variety of XY Hamiltonians.

title: Quantitatively Probing the Tilt Angle Failures in 4D-STEM Polarisation Analysis
abstract: Four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM) is increasingly used to map polarisation in ferroic textures such as domain walls, vortices, merons and skyrmions. These textures are accompanied by local strain, lattice rotation and misorientation, which also modulate the diffraction features used to infer polar order. Even small deviations from the zone axis can therefore produce contrast that is indistinguishable from a polarisation signal. Here we quantify the tilt sensitivity of two polarisation-sensitive signals, diffraction disc intensity and Kikuchi band intensity, in three ferroelectrics with distinct polar distortions: PbTiO3, BaTiO3 and Cu3B7O13Cl boracite. We find that tilts of only 0.01-0.05 degrees reverse most Friedel-pair disc asymmetries, and even the most robust disc pairs reverse by 0.04 degrees in BaTiO3, 0.14 degrees in PbTiO3 and 0.18 degrees in boracite, producing contrast equal and opposite to that of the polarisation. Kikuchi band contrast is the only signal that reports absolute polarity without knowledge of the specimen thickness, but it does so only up to 0.09 degrees in PbTiO3, 0.015 degrees in BaTiO3 and 0.02 degrees in boracite. From these results we define tilt tolerances for each signal and material, and propose practical criteria for distinguishing polarisation contrast from misorientation. The analysis also applies to scanning electron microscopy-based diffraction, including electron backscatter diffraction.

title: Strain control of magneto-optical properties of ultra-thin Ni-Mn-Ga films grown by magnetron sputtering
abstract: Ultra-thin epitaxial Ni-Mn-Ga films, 10-15 nm thick, were grown by magnetron sputtering on MgO(001), either directly on the substrate or on a Cr buffer, and studied by X-ray diffraction, magnetometry, and magneto-optical Kerr effect (MOKE) spectroscopy. The films were austenitic, with the cubic cell tetragonally distorted in opposite directions. The film on bare MgO was stretched in-plane ($c/a=0.989$) and the film on Cr was compressed in-plane ($c/a=1.021$), while their unit-cell volumes differed by less than $0.3\%$. As the thermal expansion mismatch was expected to stretch the films in-plane in both cases, the opposite distortions were attributed to the lattice misfit. The room-temperature magnetization loops of the two films did not show significant differences, but their polar and longitudinal MOKE spectra differed in the amplitude, sign, and energy of the spectral structures over the whole 0.76-5 eV range. Magneto-optical simulations showed that the absence of the Cr buffer accounted only for the stronger low-energy polar MOKE rotation extremum of the film on MgO. We attributed the other changes to the strain-induced change of the electronic structure, consistent with theoretical predictions in which the $d_{x^2-y^2}$ and $d_{3z^2-r^2}$ sub-bands of the minority-spin Ni $e_g$ states exchange their order when the distortion changes sign. In parts of the spectrum, the two films showed Kerr rotation or ellipticity of opposite sign, so the choice of the growth template or a dynamically induced distortion can switch the sign of the magneto-optical response at a given photon energy.

title: Majorana-like Josephson branch structure in one-dimensional transport of cold atoms
abstract: We study phase-controlled transport through a one-dimensional channel of attractively interacting fermions connecting two three-dimensional BCS reservoirs. The competition between channel phase stiffness and pair tunnelling at the two contacts results in the emergence of two $4\pi$-periodic families of stationary states, characterised by symmetric or asymmetric phase drops at the boundaries. Advancing the reservoir phase difference by $2\pi$ exchanges these families so that the equilibrium energy remains $2\pi$ periodic, while the $4\pi $ periodicity might be attained in a diabatic regime. This structure admits a formal description in terms of two boundary Majorana operators, combining into a nonlocal fermion mode. Renormalization-group analysis shows that quantum fluctuations and phase slips are suppressed in the zero-temperature thermodynamic limit, preserving the branch crossings. The predicted branch exchange, metastable currents, and sweep-rate-dependent switching provide experimentally testable signatures of Majorana-like Josephson branch physics in a gapless interacting channel.

summaries.en: The paper predicts that a one-dimensional channel of attractively interacting cold fermions between two BCS reservoirs exhibits two 4π-periodic families of stationary states, exchangeable by advancing the reservoir phase by 2π and formally describable via two boundary Majorana operators forming a nonlocal fermion mode, with quantum fluctuations and phase slips suppressed in the zero-temperature thermodynamic limit.
summaries.zh: 该论文预测，连接两个BCS库的吸引相互作用冷原子一维通道会出现两个4π周期的定态族，将储库相位推进2π可交换这两个族，并可用两个边界马约拉纳算符组成的非局域费米子模式形式描述，而在零温热力学极限下量子涨落和相位滑移被抑制。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、2つのBCSリザーバーを結ぶ引力相互作用する冷却フェルミ原子の一次元チャネルにおいて、リザーバーの位相を2π進めると交換される2つの4π周期的定常状態族が現れ、それらは非局所フェルミオンmodeを成す2つの境界Majorana演算子で形式的に記述でき、ゼロ温度の熱力学的極限では量子揺らぎと位相スリップが抑制されることを予測している。

title: Evolutionary Design of Interpretable Spatial Descriptors for Structure-Property Relationship Discovery
abstract: Structure property prediction is a classical task in machine learning, ranging from molecular activity and materials properties to local functional responses measured in microscopy. For image-based regression, two choices define the information available to the predictor: the size of the image neighborhood and the spatial resolution retained within it. A small neighborhood can omit relevant surrounding structure, whereas a large, finely sampled neighborhood can introduce redundant or irrelevant information. Here, we develop a framework for constructing spatial descriptors for prediction of local spectra and hysteresis loops. We benchmark regression models, use SHAP maps to examine their spatial attribution, and explore the effect of the patch size and compression to establish the relationship between predictive accuracy and descriptor dimensionality. We then use a genetic algorithm to optimize spatial partitions and the assignment of mean, minimum, and maximum pooling operations. Each retained region contributes an explicit measurement of the image, allowing the search to balance prediction error against the number of descriptor values. Cartesian and polar constructions provide complementary ways to organize this information. The resulting descriptors make it possible to examine where spatial detail is needed, where regional summaries are sufficient, and how these choices depend on the predictor and the measured response. The same approach can be used for molecules and solids once the genetic algorithm rules for these are established.

summaries.en: The paper develops a genetic-algorithm framework that optimizes spatial partitions and pooling operations to construct interpretable, low-dimensional image descriptors for predicting local spectra and hysteresis loops, revealing where fine spatial detail versus regional summaries are needed.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出了一种遗传算法框架，通过优化空间划分和池化操作来构建可解释的低维图像描述符，用于预测局部光谱和磁滞回线，并揭示何处需要精细空间细节、何处区域汇总即已足够。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、空間分割とプーリング操作を最適化する遺伝的アルゴリズムの枠組みを開発し、局所スペクトルやヒステリシスループの予測に向けた解釈可能で低次元の画像記述子を構築するとともに、どこで細かな空間的詳細が必要か、どこで領域要約で十分かを明らかにする。

title: Holographic dark energy through Kruglov entropy
abstract: We study a holographic dark energy model built on the new entropy proposed by Kruglov, $S_K=S_{BH}/(1+\gamma S_{BH}^2)$, with the Granda--Oliveros infrared cutoff $L^{-2}=\alpha H^2+\beta\dot H$ in a flat universe. The Kruglov entropy is smaller than the Bekenstein--Hawking entropy and has a maximum value. We obtain the energy density of the model, the differential equation for the dark energy density parameter, and the expressions for the equation of state parameter, the deceleration parameter and the squared sound speed. At early times the model behaves like the usual Granda--Oliveros holographic dark energy, and the dark energy follows the background with a constant fraction. At late times the Kruglov correction gives a stable de Sitter future when $\alpha>1$, with the final Hubble rate fixed by the entropy parameter. The model gives a matter era followed by a dark energy era, with a transition from deceleration to acceleration near $z\approx0.66$. For larger values of the entropy parameter the equation of state can cross the phantom divide; for the parameters allowed by the data this happens only in the future, if at all. We constrain the model with 31 cosmic chronometer points, Pantheon+ supernovae and DESI DR2 baryon acoustic oscillation data, together with a big bang nucleosynthesis condition, using a Markov chain Monte Carlo analysis. We find $H_0=68.0\pm1.6$ km\,s$^{-1}$\,Mpc$^{-1}$, $\alpha=1.19^{+0.10}_{-0.08}$, $\beta=0.61^{+0.06}_{-0.05}$ and the 95\% upper limit $\tilde b=b/H_0^4<0.24$ on the dimensionless Kruglov parameter (for a matter-era dark energy fraction below 0.3), which gives $\gamma<4.9\times10^{-246}$. The present equation of state is $w_{D0}=-0.83\pm0.03$. The model fits the data slightly better than $\Lambda$CDM ($\Delta\chi^2=-4.5$) and is equally good by the Akaike criterion, while the Bayesian criterion and the Bayesian evidence prefer $\Lambda$CDM.

summaries.en: We study a holographic dark energy model built on the new entropy proposed by Kruglov, $S_K=S_{BH}/(1+\gamma S_{BH}^2)$, with the Granda--Oliveros infrared cutoff $L^{-2}=\alpha H^2+\beta\dot H$ in a flat universe.
summaries.zh: 我们研究了基于 Kruglov 提出的新熵 $S_K=S_{BH}/(1+\gamma S_{BH}^2)$ 建立的全息暗能量模型，在平坦宇宙中具有 Granda--Oliveros 红外截止线 $L^{-2}=\alpha H^2+\beta\dot H$。
summaries.ja: 私たちは、クルグロフによって提案された新しいエントロピー $S_K=S_{BH}/(1+\gamma S_{BH}^2)$ に基づいて構築されたホログラフィック ダーク エネルギー モデルを、平面宇宙におけるグランダ-オリベロスの赤外線カットオフ $L^{-2}=\alpha H^2+\beta\dot H$ とともに研究します。

title: Neuromorphic Camera for Multi-Target Pointing Acquisition and Tracking in Free Space Optical Communication
abstract: Pointing, Acquisition, and Tracking (PAT) in Free-Space Optical Communication (FSOC) applications must achieve both low jitter and a large Field of View (FoV) to support beacon acquisition and multi-target tracking. While conventional frame-based sensors provide the necessary angular coverage, their performance is limited by latency, available frame-rate, and motion blur. This work explores and demonstrates the application of an event-based vision sensor for PAT tasks in FSOC. The system employs a neuromorphic sensor that asynchronously records brightness changes (events) with microsecond-level temporal resolution. The main contribution of this paper is a comparative analysis of event-based tracking algorithms for the simultaneous acquisition and tracking of multiple optical beacons that operate directly on this asynchronous stream. The performance of these strategies is validated on an experimental dataset representing realistic operational conditions for dynamic High-Altitude Platform (HAP) and Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) networks. The analysis compares key metrics, such as tracking accuracy and processing latency, under various signal-to-background conditions.

summaries.en: This paper explores an event-based neuromorphic camera for pointing, acquisition, and tracking in free-space optical communication, contributing a comparative analysis of event-based tracking algorithms that simultaneously acquire and track multiple optical beacons directly on the asynchronous event stream, validated on an experimental dataset representing realistic HAP and UAV network conditions.
summaries.zh: 本文探索了基于事件的神经形态相机在自由空间光通信指向、捕获与跟踪中的应用，主要贡献是对直接在异步事件流上同时捕获并跟踪多个光学信标的基于事件的跟踪算法进行比较分析，并在代表真实高空平台（HAP）和无人机（UAV）网络条件的实验数据集上进行了验证。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、自由空間光通信におけるポインティング・捕捉・追跡のためのイベントベースのニューロモルフィックカメラを検討し、非同期イベントストリーム上で直接複数の光学ビーコンを同時に捕捉・追跡するイベントベーストラッキングアルゴリズムの比較分析を主な貢献として、現実的なHAPおよびUAVネットワーク条件を表す実験データセットで検証した。

title: A closed-form design rule for photonic hopfions of arbitrary order
abstract: Topological textures of light are robust against perturbation and are emerging as carriers of information and probes of light-matter interaction. The most intricate of them, the photonic hopfion, in which the loops of different polarization states are linked, has so far been assembled from chosen superpositions of laser modes, with weights set by hand or found by numerical optimization. Here we replace this search with a design rule. Two scalar beams, an optical vortex of order $\ell$ and a field with n dark rings, propagate in closed form, and their phases on one plane are the two masks of a metasurface that controls two orthogonal polarizations. Although a beam, unlike the closed spaces of topology, extends to infinity, we prove that it is a hopfion of order $n\ell$ whenever three algebraic conditions on the ring coefficients and the vortex order hold, and that the polarization loops of every state that the far field does not reach then link exactly $n\ell$ times; each condition guards against one way in which the topology can escape. The order is thus chosen on paper and the device follows directly, without optimization. In scalar simulation, one terahertz metasurface geometry produces hopfions up to order nine, and a full-wave simulation of the complete first-order device preserves its topology. The rule applies to any platform that shapes the phases of two orthogonal polarizations.

summaries.en: The paper presents a closed-form design rule that constructs photonic hopfions of arbitrary order by encoding the phases of an optical vortex and a multi-ring scalar field as two polarization masks on a metasurface, with three algebraic conditions guaranteeing that the resulting beam is a hopfion of order nℓ whose polarization loops link exactly nℓ times, verified in terahertz scalar and full-wave simulations up to order nine.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出了一种闭式设计规则，通过将光学涡旋和多暗环标量场的相位编码为超表面上的两个正交偏振掩模来构造任意阶光子霍普夫子，并给出三个代数条件以保证所得光束是阶数为nℓ的霍普夫子、其偏振环路恰好链接nℓ次，并在高达九阶的太赫兹标量模拟和全波模拟中得到验证。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、光学渦と複数の暗環をもつスカラー場の位相をメタサーフェス上の直交する2つの偏光マスクとして符号化することで任意次数のフォトニック・ホプフィオンを構成する閉形式の設計則を提示し、環係数と渦次数に関する3つの代数条件が満たされれば得られるビームが次数nℓのホプフィオンでありその偏光ループが正確にnℓ回連結することを証明し、9次までのテラヘルツスカラーシミュレーションと完全な全波シミュレーションで検証している。

title: Time-resolved infrared spectroscopy with entangled photons and visible-light detection
abstract: Time-resolved infrared (TR-IR) spectroscopy reveals molecular structural changes and charge-carrier dynamics on their intrinsic timescales, in photosynthesis, catalysis and optoelectronic materials, but requires complex sources of ultrashort infrared pulses, cryogenically cooled detectors to overcome thermal background, and intense probes that can perturb the sample. Quantum infrared spectroscopy avoids these constraints: harnessing quantum interference between the generation processes of frequency-entangled photon pairs, it reads out the infrared response of a sample by detecting only the visible partner photon, for which efficient detectors exist. To date, it has been limited to steady-state measurements. Here we demonstrate its ultrafast, time-resolved form with a picosecond visible pump pulse and a silicon detector. Each visible pulse generates photon pairs within a picosecond window; the infrared photon of a pair probes the excited sample at a set delay after excitation, and the transient response is read out from the count rate of its visible partner. We resolve picosecond carrier dynamics in a semiconductor saturable absorber mirror near 1529 nm with a picowatt-level probe, unaffected by thermal background and by sample IR photoluminescence 50 times stronger than the probe. The approach is applicable to the mid-infrared, fingerprint region, where infrared detection is hardest, and to the terahertz region.

summaries.en: Time-resolved infrared spectroscopy is demonstrated using frequency-entangled photon pairs in which the infrared photon probes an excited sample and the transient response is read out by detecting only its visible partner photon with a silicon detector, resolving picosecond carrier dynamics near 1529 nm with picowatt-level probe power while being unaffected by thermal background and strong sample IR photoluminescence.
summaries.zh: 本文展示了利用频率纠缠光子对实现的时间分辨红外光谱技术，其中红外光子探测激发后的样品，而仅通过硅探测器检测其可见光伴生光子来读取瞬态响应，以皮瓦级探测光在1529 nm附近分辨出皮秒级载流子动力学，且不受热背景和比探测光强50倍的样品红外光致发光影响。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、周波数もつれ光子対を用いた時間分解赤外分光を実証したもので、赤外光子が励起試料をプローブし、その可視光パートナー光子のみをシリコン検出器で検出して過渡応答を読み出すことで、ピコワット級のプローブ光により1529 nm付近のピコ秒のキャリアダイナミクスを、熱的背景やプローブ光の50倍強い試料の赤外フォトルミネセンスの影響を受けずに分解した。

title: Sympathetic Cooling of Ionic Fullerenes with Ultracold Atoms to Millikelvin Temperatures
abstract: Cooling complex molecular ions to millikelvin temperatures remains a major challenge because their intricate internal structures prevent laser cooling. Here, we propose to use an ultracold gas of Cd atoms to efficiently cool C$_{60}^+$ ions to average kinetic energies of approximately 20 mK, following an initial precooling stage with He buffer gas. Our approach is based on full molecular dynamics simulations using accurate ion-atom interaction potentials derived from high-level electronic structure methods. Furthermore, using a Monte Carlo approach, we predict the formation of C$_{60}^+$ Coulomb crystals supported solely by collisions with the buffer gas. The probability of reaching these cold states shows a pronounced dependence on the number of trapped ions, revealing the competition between neutral-atom cooling and many-ion dynamics in radio-frequency traps.

summaries.en: Using full molecular dynamics simulations with accurate ion-atom interaction potentials, the authors show that an ultracold Cd gas can sympathetically cool C60+ ions to average kinetic energies of about 20 mK after He buffer-gas precooling, and predict the formation of C60+ Coulomb crystals supported solely by buffer-gas collisions with a probability strongly dependent on the number of trapped ions.
summaries.zh: 作者利用基于高精度离子-原子相互作用势的完整分子动力学模拟表明，经过氦缓冲气体预冷却后，超冷镉原子气体可将C60+离子协同冷却至约20 mK的平均动能，并预测仅靠缓冲气体碰撞即可形成C60+库仑晶体，其形成概率显著依赖于囚禁离子数目。
summaries.ja: 著者らは、高精度なイオン-原子相互作用ポテンシャルを用いた完全な分子動力学シミュレーションにより、ヘリウムバッファーガスによる予備冷却後、極低温のCd原子気体がC60+イオンを約20 mKの平均運動エネルギーまで交感冷却できることを示し、さらにバッファーガスとの衝突のみで支持されるC60+クーロン結晶の形成を予測するとともに、その形成確率がトラップされたイオン数に顕著に依存することを明らかにした。

title: Optical angular momentum and pseudospin-orbit coupling in photonic graphene
abstract: We investigate the dynamics of structured laser beams carrying angular momentum (AM) as they undergo conical diffraction in photonic graphene. Using a combination of numerical simulations and analytical calculations, we demonstrate a surprising result: the beam's orbital AM tracks the dynamics of the lattice pseudospin rather than the AM of its slowly varying envelope. This finding provides evidence that pseudospin behaves as a genuine form of angular momentum. Furthermore, we explore beam propagation in staggered honeycomb lattices governed by the massive Dirac equation, revealing that the orbital AM is highly sensitive to both the band gap size and the envelope's initial AM. We explain our numerical results by drawing an analogy with the orbital magnetization of electrons.

summaries.en: This study shows that structured laser beams undergoing conical diffraction in photonic graphene have their orbital angular momentum track the lattice pseudospin dynamics rather than the angular momentum of the slowly varying envelope, providing evidence that pseudospin behaves as a genuine form of angular momentum, with beam propagation in staggered honeycomb lattices governed by the massive Dirac equation revealing orbital angular momentum that is highly sensitive to band gap size and initial envelope angular momentum and is explained via analogy with electron orbital magnetization.
summaries.zh: 本研究表明，在光子石墨烯中发生锥形衍射的结构化激光束，其轨道角动量追踪的是晶格赝自旋的动力学，而非其缓变包络的角动量，这为赝自旋是一种真正的角动量形式提供了证据，并且在由大质量狄拉克方程支配的交错蜂窝晶格中，光束传播所展现的轨道角动量对带隙大小和包络初始角动量高度敏感，这一结果可通过与电子轨道磁化进行类比来解释。
summaries.ja: 本研究は、フォトニックグラフェン中で円錐回折を起こす構造化レーザービームの軌道角運動量が、ゆっくり変化する包絡線の角運動量ではなく格子の擬スピンのダイナミクスに追従することを示し、擬スピンが真正な角運動量の一形態として振る舞う証拠を与えるとともに、大質量ディラック方程式に支配されるスタガード蜂の巣格子におけるビーム伝搬では軌道角運動量がバンドギャップの大きさと包絡線の初期角運動量に強く依存し、それが電子の軌道磁化との類推によって説明できることを明らかにした。

title: Single-sided lens terahertz flat-top beam shaping in the Fresnel region
abstract: In this paper, a novel, to our knowledge, analytical approach is introduced for the design of a single-sided plano-convex lens (PCL) capable of terahertz (THz) flat-top beam shaping in the Fresnel region. The lens profile, derived from geometrical optics principles, integrates collimating and beam-shaping functions into a single optical surface, thereby simplifying fabrication. The efficiency of the method is demonstrated by designing two PCLs that convert a divergent Gaussian beam from a monochromatic THz source (at 100 and 200 GHz) into flat-top beams with target radii of 400 and 500 mm at distances of 3 and 4 m, respectively. The resulting fields, evaluated through analytical, integral equation, and finite element techniques, are shown to be comparable to those produced by a conventional double-sided concave-convex lens. Furthermore, the sensitivity of the design to frequency and alignment variations is investigated, confirming the robustness of this single-curvature approach for integration into practical THz imaging systems.

summaries.en: This paper introduces an analytical design for a single-sided plano-convex lens that integrates collimating and beam-shaping functions on one optical surface to generate terahertz flat-top beams in the Fresnel region, with simulations at 100 and 200 GHz showing performance comparable to a conventional double-sided concave-convex lens and robustness to frequency and alignment variations.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种单面平凸透镜的解析设计方法，将准直与光束整形功能集成于单一光学表面，用于在菲涅尔区产生太赫兹平顶光束；在100和200 GHz下的仿真表明其性能可与传统双面凹凸透镜相当，并对频率和对准变化具有鲁棒性。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、コリメーションとビーム整形の機能を単一の光学面に統合した片面平凸レンズの解析的設計法を提案し、フレネル領域におけるテラヘルツ平頂ビーム生成について、100および200 GHzでのシミュレーションにより従来の両面凹凸レンズに匹敵する性能と周波数・位置ずれに対する堅牢性を示した。

title: Colloidal 2D WS2 nanosheets exhibiting high-purity single photon emission
abstract: The search for quantum emitters, delivering single photons "on demand" at cryogenic and elevated temperatures for photonic technologies is ever progressing. For example, micrometer-sized WS2 monolayers exhibit single photon emission by elaborated local defect or strain engineering. Here, we show that wet-chemically synthesised monolayered two-dimensional (2D) WS2 nano sheets (NSs) with lateral sizes of 14 (+/- 6 nm) readily emit single photons from exciton recombination without the need for substrate-induced patterning, strain/defect engineering or spectral filtering. Single particle spectroscopy of 70 individual NSs shows photoluminescence from excitons (2.02 eV), trios (1.94 eV) and defect-localized states (1.85 eV) with fast emission (t1<0.2 ns, t2=3.2 ns), allowing highly frequent excitation cycles. Pulsed at 80 MHz, colloidal WS2 NSs exhibit limited spectral diffusion, no blinking and distinct photon antibunching (g2(0)=0.07 at 5 K), thereby tackling challenges of established colloidal quantum dot systems (blinking, longer emission cycles), while retaining high single photon purity as key quality of deterministic quantum emitters.

title: BIC-Engineered Silicon Nitride Microring Resonators Enabled by an Etch-Free Laser-Writing Approach
abstract: We report the initial experimental demonstration of a complementary, etch-free approach with fewer fabrication steps, in useful SU-8 ridges written by direct ultraviolet laser lithography on an unpatterned silicon nitride film define waveguides and microring resonators. Because the nitride film is never patterned, scattering at patterned nitride sidewalls does not arise, and the remaining radiative loss is engineered by design. The guided transverse-magnetic mode lies within the continuum of transverse-electric slab modes, and we use bound states in the continuum (BICs) as a design tool to control this radiation. Coupled-mode analysis and full-vectorial simulations show that radiation from the two ridge sidewalls cancels by destructive interference at discrete widths, with a first BIC at 2.25 micron and radiation below 1 dB/cm over a 0.3 micron width window and about 200 nm of bandwidth, and that curvature confines this cancellation to discrete bands of bending radius and width. Laser-written waveguides follow the predicted width dependence of the loss, reaching approximately 1.5 dB/cm near the BIC, where non-radiative loss dominates. A microring designed on a radius-selected BIC band exhibits loaded quality factors up to 1.6 \times 10^4 and, under the over-coupled assignment supported by a coupler model, an intrinsic quality factor of 3.3 \times 10^5. Because radiation is set by a patterned low-index layer on an unetched film, the same approach could be extended to other nanostructures. Optimization of the writing conditions and materials is ongoing.

summaries.en: This paper reports the first experimental demonstration of an etch-free, direct ultraviolet laser lithography approach that writes SU-8 ridges on an unpatterned silicon nitride film to form waveguides and microring resonators, using bound states in the continuum (BIC) engineering to cancel sidewall radiation and achieve losses near 1.
summaries.zh: 本文首次实验演示了一种无需刻蚀的直接紫外激光光刻方法，在未图案化的氮化硅薄膜上写入SU-8脊形结构以制备波导和微环谐振器，并利用连续域束缚态（BIC）工程使两侧壁辐射相消，在波导中实现约1.
summaries.ja: 本論文は、パターニングされていない窒化シリコン膜上にSU-8リッジを直接紫外レーザーリソグラフィで書き込むことで導波路とマイクロリング共振器を形成する、エッチング不要の手法を初めて実験的に実証し、連続域束縛状態（BIC）工学により両側壁からの放射を相殺して導波路で約1.

title: Hyperbolic Nanocavities for Single-Molecule Vibrational Strong Coupling
abstract: Hyperbolic phonon polaritons (HPhPs) in low-loss anisotropic materials such as hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) provide extreme sub-diffractional field confinement in the mid-infrared, making them attractive for enhancing the interaction of light with molecular vibrations. Collective vibrational strong coupling between molecular ensembles and HPhPs has already been demonstrated in extended slabs. Reaching this regime with a single molecule, however, remains a major challenge, and would provide a platform for investigating how vacuum electromagnetic fields influence molecular dynamics and chemical reactivity. Here, we show theoretically that single-molecule vibrational strong coupling can be reached in hBN nanocavities that laterally confine HPhPs within a finite volume. Combining full-wave electromagnetic simulations with the few-mode quantization approach, we find that these nanocavities support a rich set of asymmetric resonances that strongly enhance the local spectral density, with frequencies that follow from simple HPhP ray trajectories and can be tuned through the cavity aspect ratio. We identify resonances with quality factors of about $600$ and effective mode volumes of $|V_{\mathrm{eff}}| \sim 10^{-7}\lambda^{3}$, sufficient for single-molecule strong coupling with vibrational transitions with dipole moments on the order of $1\,\mathrm{D}$. These results establish hyperbolic nanocavities as a promising platform for single-molecule vibrational strong coupling and open new routes toward the local control of vibrational dynamics and molecular energy flow.
subjects: Optics (physics.optics) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall); Quantum Physics (quant-ph)

summaries.en: Theoretical calculations combining full-wave electromagnetic simulations with few-mode quantization show that hBN hyperbolic nanocavities confining hyperbolic phonon polaritons can achieve quality factors of about 600 and effective mode volumes of ~10^-7 λ^3, sufficient for vibrational strong coupling with a single molecule whose vibrational transition dipole moment is on the order of 1 D.
summaries.zh: 结合全波电磁模拟与少模量子化方法的理论计算表明，限制双曲声子极化激元的hBN双曲纳米腔可实现约600的品质因子和约10^-7 λ^3的有效模式体积，足以与振动跃迁偶极矩约为1 D的单分子实现振动强耦合。

title: A Design Rule for Passive Reconfigurable Microwave Devices
abstract: Every reconfigurable microwave device places a tuning element - a varactor, a diode, transistor, microelectromechanical or phase-change switch, a ferroelectric or liquid-crystal load - inside a fixed passive network. The network can make a small change of the element produce a large change of the response, and design practice often credits it with the device's tuning capability. This paper shows that a fixed, linear, passive network cannot add to that capability. Each tuning element carries a tuning budget, a dimensionless length computed from its own impedance trajectory, and a fixed passive network can transmit that budget or lose part of it, never enlarge it. The unit of the budget is the hyperbolic distance of the Smith chart: the distance from a match is the logarithm of the voltage standing-wave ratio, and the distance between two states sets their mutual mismatch and is the logarithm of their commutation quality factor. From one inequality we derive closed-form, ready-to-use limits for analog and digital phase shifters, true-time-delay lines, switches, attenuators, vector modulators, impedance tuners, tunable filters, reconfigurable antennas, metasurface cells and multiport networks; the two-state and attenuation limits are attained by explicit circuits, and the phase limit by a constant-loss trajectory. We introduce the $\Lambda$-chart, a Smith-chart companion on which budgets and requirements are read graphically, and apply it to four published microwave case studies.

summaries.en: This paper proves that a fixed linear passive network can only transmit or reduce, never enlarge, the intrinsic tuning budget of a tuning element, defined as the hyperbolic (Smith-chart) distance of its impedance trajectory, and derives closed-form limits for reconfigurable microwave devices along with a graphical Lambda-chart design tool.
summaries.zh: 本文证明固定的线性无源网络只能传递或损耗、而无法放大调谐元件自身的调谐预算（即其阻抗轨迹在史密斯圆图上的双曲距离），并由此推导出各类可重构微波器件的闭式极限，同时提出图形化的Λ图设计工具。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、固定された線形受動ネットワークがチューニング素子固有のチューニング予算（スミスチャート上の双曲距離で定義されるインピーダンス軌跡の長さ）を伝達または減少させることはできても拡大することはできないことを示し、各種再構成可能マイクロ波デバイスの閉形式の限界を導出するとともに、グラフィカルなΛチャート設計ツールを提案する。

title: Evanescent-Depth-Engineered High-Q topological Cavities for Strong Photon-Exciton Coupling
abstract: Due to the inherent scattering in topological edge states, the topological resonant cavity (TRC) formed by their interference exhibits a relatively low quality factor (Q). To address this issue, we propose the mechanism of engineering the transverse evanescent depth of edge states to achieve high-Q in irregular shaped TRCs, which further enables strong photon-exciton coupling at the single-quantum level. By adjusting the intra- and inter-cell coupling strengths in the pseudo-spin topological photonic crystal, the transverse evanescent depth of edge states is greatly reduced, thereby suppressing the scattering of TRCs. Consequently, the Q of various shaped TRCs with 2 ~ 3 um size is up to 10^5 ~ 10^6 in the visible, so that the strong photon-exciton coupling is achieved. The high-Q topological cavities hold promising application in integrated lasers, sensors, cavity quantum electrodynamics, and quantum photonics.

summaries.en: By engineering the transverse evanescent depth of topological edge states through tuning intra- and inter-cell coupling strengths in a pseudo-spin topological photonic crystal, irregular-shaped topological resonant cavities of 2–3 µm achieve quality factors of 10^5–10^6 in the visible, enabling strong photon-exciton coupling at the single-quantum level.
summaries.zh: 通过调节赝自旋拓扑光子晶胞内与胞间耦合强度来工程化拓扑边缘态的横向倏逝深度，2~3微米尺寸的不规则拓扑谐振腔在可见光波段实现了10^5~10^6的品质因子，从而在单量子水平上实现强光子-激子耦合。
summaries.ja: 擬スピントポロジカルフォトニック結晶におけるセル内・セル間結合強度を調整してトポロジカル端状態の横方向エバネッセント深さを工学制御することで、2〜3µmの不規則形状トポロジカル共振器が可視域で10^5〜10^6のQ値を達成し、単一量子レベルでの強い光子-励起子結合が実現される。

title: Directional Control of Chiral Polymer Emission Dissymmetry by Plasmonic Metasurfaces
abstract: Circularly polarized (CP) emission is central to next-generation photonic and optoelectronic technologies, yet simultaneously controlling its directionality, intensity, and handedness remains a major challenge. Advances in molecular and materials design have enabled strong chiral light-matter interactions and large dissymmetry between opposite CP states. However, conventional thin-film architectures provide limited control over the angular distribution of CP emission and often exhibit strongly angle-dependent chiral emission. Metasurfaces, on the other hand, offer powerful control over emission directionality and polarization, but have predominantly been explored with intrinsically achiral emitters. For the first time, we integrate organic chiral polymer thin films with planar chiral plasmonic metasurfaces to enhance chiral light-matter interactions while controlling the directionality and angular dependence of chiral emission. Using angle-resolved Stokes Fourier polarimetry, we show that metasurface coupling produces directional emission, near-normal dissymmetry factors exceeding 0.7, and, remarkably, direction-dependent reversal of the emission handedness at fixed molecular stereochemistry.
subjects: Optics (physics.optics) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall); Applied Physics (physics.app-ph)

summaries.en: By integrating organic chiral polymer thin films with planar chiral plasmonic metasurfaces, the authors achieve directional control of circularly polarized emission with near-normal dissymmetry factors exceeding 0.
