title: Phase matching and mode coupling in photonic-crystal ring resonators
abstract: Photonic-crystal ring resonators, in which periodic refractive-index modulations couple counter-propagating modes, have become a widely used platform for nonlinear photonics, offering mode-by-mode dispersion engineering. When several modulation components are superimposed, their relative angular alignment (phase) is an additional degree of freedom whose impact on the nonlinear dynamics has remained unclear. Here we show that the relative phases between the modulation patterns have a decisive impact. Through the interference of the nonlinear processes in forward and backward direction, they add a phase and mode selection rule to the established phase-matching conditions, which can fully suppress nonlinear coupling. They also impose a relative spectral chirp between forward- and backward-propagating waveforms. We illustrate these effects for parametric oscillation and dissipative Kerr solitons. Our results extend the concept of phase matching to resonators with interfering nonlinear pathways and establish the alignment of index gratings as a design dimension for nonlinear microresonators.

summaries.en: This study shows that the relative phases between superimposed periodic refractive-index modulations in photonic-crystal ring resonators add a phase and mode selection rule to phase-matching conditions, capable of fully suppressing nonlinear coupling and imposing a relative spectral chirp between forward- and backward-propagating waveforms, as illustrated for parametric oscillation and dissipative Kerr solitons.
summaries.zh: 本研究表明，光子晶体环形谐振腔中叠加的周期折射率调制之间的相对相位会在相位匹配条件之上增加一条相位与模式选择规则，能够完全抑制非线性耦合，并在前向与后向传播波形之间引入相对光谱啁啾，这在参量振荡和耗散克尔孤子中得到了说明。
summaries.ja: 本研究は、フォトニック結晶リング共振器において重畳された周期的屈折率変調間の相対位相が、位相整合条件に位相・モード選択則を付加し、非線形結合を完全に抑制し得ること、また前方・後方伝搬波形間に相対的なスペクトルチャープを課すことを、パラメトリック発振と散逸カーソリトンの例で示した。

title: Effective Harmonic and Anharmonic Models for Vibronic Spectra
abstract: Vibrationally resolved spectra of medium-sized molecules contain dense progressions, weak borrowed-intensity bands and large-amplitude structural motions. Their interpretation requires state-to-state assignments together with a complete spectral envelope, while a fully anharmonic treatment of every normal coordinate is usually impractical. We introduce a general workflow that builds both outputs from automatically generated nonredundant internal coordinates and a common transition-operator representation. The harmonic level combines time-independent (TI) assignments with time-dependent (TD) thermal correlations and an explicit omitted-strength bound for the positive harmonic dipole sum. A discrete-variable representation (DVR) promotes selected flexible coordinates while the remaining modes are contracted analytically. Perturbative and variational nuclear states extend the same operator treatment to separate-state modes with Duschinsky mixing or to shared modes with residual quadratic couplings. The workflow recovers approximately 99% of the harmonic intensity for strongly reorganized medium-sized examples, reproduces measured absorption and fluorescence trends for anthracene and p-terphenyl, and gives signed electronic circular dichroism (ECD) profiles for camphor. Water photoionization, a diffuse-basis two-photon response tensor for the pyrazine $n\to3s$ Rydberg band, and nonplanar 4-pyrone calculations test continuum and anharmonic extensions. The result is a unified route from molecular structure to resolved assignments and numerically converged finite-model spectra.

summaries.en: The paper introduces a unified workflow combining harmonic time-independent and time-dependent treatments with selected anharmonic DVR, perturbative and variational corrections built on nonredundant internal coordinates and a common transition-operator representation, yielding state-to-state assignments and converged vibronic spectra that reproduce absorption, fluorescence, and ECD data for medium-sized molecules.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出了一种统一的工作流程，基于非冗余内坐标和共同的跃迁算符表示，将谐波时不变与时变处理与选择性非谐DVR、微扰及变分修正相结合，从而给出态到态的指认和数值收敛的振动光谱，并复现了中等大小分子的吸收、荧光和ECD数据。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、非冗長内部座標と共通の遷移演算子表現に基づき、調和時間依存・時間非依存解析と選択的非調和DVR、摂動・変分補正を統合したワークフローを提案し、状態間帰属と数値収束した振電スペクトルを与え、中規模分子の吸収・蛍光・ECDデータを再現する。

title: Cryogenic suppression of correlated loss in Rydberg atom arrays
abstract: Blackbody radiation (BBR) poses a central challenge for quantum science with Rydberg atoms. By driving transitions to nearby opposite-parity states, BBR shortens Rydberg lifetimes and has long been suspected to trigger "avalanche" events known to cause correlated atom loss. Here, we suppress avalanche decay and establish BBR as its dominant trigger using a Rydberg atom array that operates either cryogenically or at room temperature. A $45~\text{K}$ radiation shield reduces ambient BBR, extending Rydberg $nS$ lifetimes for $n$ ranging from 50 to 75. BBR-induced decay rates are suppressed by 30%-50%, corresponding to an effective blackbody temperature $T_{\rm eff}\approx190~\text{K}$. This enables controlled comparisons of Rydberg-dressed atom arrays operating in different BBR environments. Arrays of up to 70 atoms demonstrate cryogenically suppressed avalanche rates, tracking the suppression in BBR-induced decay, for both $n=50$ and $n=60$ dressing. A parameter-free rate model agrees with the measured avalanche rates after accounting for frequency-dependent cryogenic shielding, photoionization-triggered avalanches, laser phase noise, BBR decay channels, and Rydberg interaction effects. We demonstrate a quantitative description of avalanche decay and show that improved BBR shielding should further suppress correlated loss to the $T_\text{eff}=45~\text{K}$ achievable in the current apparatus. Our results establish a route to mitigating correlated errors that otherwise impede fault-tolerant operation in neutral-atom quantum processors.
subjects: Atomic Physics (physics.atom-ph) ; Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas); Quantum Physics (quant-ph)

summaries.en: Using a Rydberg atom array operated at room temperature and behind a 45 K radiation shield, the authors show that blackbody radiation is the dominant trigger of correlated avalanche atom loss and that cryogenic shielding suppresses BBR-induced decay rates by 30%-50%, enabling a parameter-free rate model to quantitatively describe avalanche decay and pointing to a route for mitigating correlated errors in neutral-atom quantum processors.
summaries.zh: 利用可在低温或室温下运行的里德堡原子阵列，作者证明黑体辐射是相关雪崩原子损失的主要触发因素，45 K辐射屏蔽将黑体辐射诱导的衰减率抑制30%-50%，并可用无参数速率模型定量描述雪崩衰减，为抑制中性原子量子处理器中的相关误差提供了途径。
summaries.ja: 低温または室温で動作するリュードベリ原子配列を用いて、黒体放射が相関的なアバランシェ原子損失の主要な引き金であることを示し、45 Kの放射シールドにより黒体放射誘起の減衰率が30%〜50%抑制され、パラメータフリーのレートモデルでアバランシェ減衰を定量的に記述できることを示した研究で、中性原子量子プロセッサにおける相関誤りの抑制への道筋を提示している。

title: Geometric Pumping of Optical Work in Coherent Wave Scattering
abstract: Optical work exchanged between light and time-varying matter underlies a wide range of emerging photonic technologies, yet a general geometric theory describing its generation and control has been lacking. Here we establish such a theory for coherent electromagnetic scattering. We show that the net optical work accumulated during an adiabatic modulation cycle is a geometric quantity determined by the Berry curvature of the outgoing field in parameter space. Nonzero optical work can thus be generated by cyclically modulating two or more independent system parameters. In contrast to conventional adiabatic pumping between incoherent reservoirs, optical work pumping vanishes under maximally mixed illumination. Greater illumination coherence increases the maximum work attainable through wavefront shaping. For fully coherent illumination, we derive the optimal incident wavefront and modulation trajectory that maximize the optical work per cycle. Our framework unifies time-varying photonics, optomechanics, and geometric transport within a common scattering formalism.

summaries.en: The paper develops a geometric theory of optical work in coherent electromagnetic scattering, showing that the net work over an adiabatic modulation cycle is a geometric quantity set by the Berry curvature of the outgoing field in parameter space, that it vanishes under maximally mixed illumination while increasing with illumination coherence, and that for fully coherent illumination the optimal incident wavefront and modulation trajectory maximizing work per cycle can be derived.
summaries.zh: 该论文建立了相干电磁散射中光学功的几何理论，证明绝热调制周期内累积的净光学功是由出射场在参数空间中的贝里曲率决定的几何量，在完全混合照明下该功消失而随照明相干性提高而增大，并针对完全相干照明推导出使每周期光学功最大的最优入射波前与调制轨迹。
summaries.ja: 本論文はコヒーレント電磁散乱における光学仕事の幾何学的理論を構築し、断熱変調サイクルで蓄積される正味の光学仕事がパラメータ空間における出射場のベリー曲率で決まる幾何学的量であること、完全混合照明では消失し照明のコヒーレンスが高いほど増大すること、完全コヒーレント照明では1サイクル当たりの光学仕事を最大化する最適な入射波面と変調経路を導出できることを示した。

title: Photonic and Electronic Interaction of TMD-Hybridized ZnO Nanowire Lasers
abstract: Semiconductor nanowire lasers are promising on-chip coherent light sources for photonic integrated circuits, but integration inevitably places them in contact with other materials, thereby changing their properties upon hybridization. In this study, we examine the photonic and electronic coupling between single ZnO nanowire lasers and TMDs. Using deterministic nanomanipulation, we first hybridized the same nanowire first with a WS$_2$ monolayer and then with a MoS$_2$ monolayer. The respective lasing threshold rises, the emission is strongly quenched at high pump power densities, and the mode envelope blueshifts. Upon hybridization with bilayer, trilayer, and bulk MoS$_2$, lasing is fully suppressed. Finite-Difference Eigenmode simulations show that the TMD absorbs part of the evanescent field. Because this absorption is wavelength dependent, it also removes modes from the low-energy flank of the envelope, which accounts for small difference between the two monolayers, while the blueshift itself follows the increase of the carrier density at threshold. Density functional theory calculations that include the interface dipole predict a type-I alignment at the ideal ZnO(10$\bar{1}$0)/TMD interface, which turns into type~II for a moderately reduced dipole, as expected for hydroxylated facets in air. In both cases, holes are transferred from the nanowire into the TMD and removed from the gain medium. Evanescent absorption and hole transfer thus jointly suppress lasing, and both must be accounted for when integrating nanowire lasers with 2D materials.

summaries.en: Hybridizing single ZnO nanowire lasers with TMD monolayers raises the lasing threshold, blueshifts the mode envelope, and quenches emission at high pump power, while thicker MoS2 fully suppresses lasing, because wavelength-dependent evanescent absorption in the TMD and hole transfer from the nanowire jointly remove gain.
summaries.zh: 将单个ZnO纳米线激光器与过渡金属硫族化合物（TMD）单层杂化会提高激射阈值、使模式包络蓝移并在高泵浦功率密度下强烈淬灭发光，而更厚的MoS2则完全抑制激射，因为TMD中波长相关的倏逝波吸收与从纳米线向TMD的空穴转移共同移除了增益。
summaries.ja: 単一ZnOナノワイヤレーザーをTMD単層とハイブリッド化すると、発振閾値が上昇し、モード包絡がブルーシフトし、高い励起パワー密度で発光が強く消光する一方、より厚いMoS2では発振が完全に抑制され、これはTMDにおける波長依存のエバネッセント吸収とナノワイヤからTMDへの正孔移動が協働して利得を除去するためである。

title: 3D Printed Monolithic Optomechanical Chassis for an Unbalanced Field-Widened Interferometer
abstract: Additive manufacturing is increasingly being explored as an approach for producing complex structures for optical hardware. In this work, we present a fully monolithic optomechanical chassis fabricated using laser powder bed fusion additive manufacturing. The structure was fabricated from thermally stable Invar36, a low-thermal-expansion alloy that enables high dimensional stability under varying environmental conditions. Our monolithic design incorporates embedded optical mounts, flexures, and alignment features directly into the chassis geometry that exceed the practical limits of conventional subtractive manufacturing. By integrating the optomechanical support structure into a single compact unit, the system achieves a reduced footprint compared to traditional optomechanical assemblies. The results demonstrate the potential of additive manufacturing to produce lightweight, and highly customized optical systems, opening the possibility of new pathways for next-generation quantum sensors and optical instrumentation.

summaries.en: This paper presents a fully monolithic optomechanical chassis fabricated from thermally stable Invar36 using laser powder bed fusion additive manufacturing, incorporating embedded optical mounts, flexures, and alignment features to achieve a reduced footprint and open new pathways for next-generation quantum sensors and optical instrumentation.
summaries.zh: 本文介绍了一种采用激光粉末床熔融增材制造技术、由热稳定的Invar36合金制成的全整体式光机械机架，其将光学安装座、柔性结构和对准特征直接嵌入几何结构中，从而减小了占用空间，并为下一代量子传感器和光学仪器开辟了新途径。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、熱安定性の高いInvar36を用いてレーザーパウダーベッド溶融積層造形で作製された完全モノリシックな光機械シャーシを提示し、光学マウント、フレクシャ、アライメント機能を幾何構造に直接埋め込むことで設置面積を削減し、次世代量子センサーや光学機器への新たな道を開くものである。

title: Dynamically modulated light-matter interactions for ancilla-tolerant bosonic control
abstract: Strong light-matter interactions are central to state-of-the-art quantum technologies, spanning platforms as diverse as Rydberg atoms, trapped ions, and superconducting circuits. In superconducting circuits, the strong dispersive coupling between microwave photons (light) and ancillary qubits (matter) has enabled universal bosonic control and quantum error correction. However, this always-on dispersive interaction propagates errors from the ancillary qubits to the bosonic systems both while idling and when performing operations, introducing a trade-off between control strength and fidelity. We break this trade-off by introducing a parametrically activated hybridization between the bosonic modes and ancilla qubits, keeping both elements decoupled when not active. When activated, this hybridization mediates a dynamic light-matter coupling with non-trivial engineered symmetries, permitting resilience to ancilla decay and dephasing. This dynamic coupling functions as a new control primitive that offers a route to bosonic processors whose performance is set by the oscillator, rather than the ancilla.

summaries.en: The paper introduces a parametrically activated, switchable hybridization between bosonic modes and ancilla qubits in superconducting circuits that keeps them decoupled when idle and, when activated, provides a dynamic light-matter coupling with engineered symmetries that is resilient to ancilla decay and dephasing, breaking the trade-off between control strength and fidelity imposed by always-on dispersive interactions.
summaries.zh: 该论文在超导电路中引入玻色模式与辅助量子比特之间参数激活的可切换杂化，使二者在空闲时保持解耦，而在激活时提供具有工程化对称性、能抵抗辅助比特衰减和退相干的动态光-物质耦合，从而打破了始终开启的色散相互作用在控制强度与保真度之间造成的权衡。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、超伝導回路においてボソニックモードと補助量子ビットの間にパラメトリックに活性化される可変的ハイブリダイゼーションを導入し、非活性時には両者を結合させず、活性時には補助量子ビットの減衰や位相緩和に耐性を持つ工学的対称性を備えた動的な光-物質結合を実現することで、常時オンの分散相互作用が課す制御強度と忠実度のトレードオフを打破する。

title: Noise-Induced Topology in Chiral Quantum Walks
abstract: Noise typically destroys quantum coherence and washes out transport phenomena that rely on interference. Chiral quantum walks are a case in point: a particle hopping on a lattice threaded by a magnetic flux can spread asymmetrically due to interference between paths, an asymmetry that noise is expected to erase. Remarkably, we find that the most ubiquitous noise -- random fluctuations of on-site energies (dephasing) -- instead renders this asymmetry topologically robust. The density profile develops a skewness that grows in time while its center stays fixed, and in a finite chain the late-time relaxation modes pile up at one edge: a skin effect lacking the drift of conventional non-Hermitian skin effects. With multiple sites per unit cell, the dephasing strength alone can cause a topological phase transition, reversing the asymmetry. On a flux ladder with noisy rung hopping, the noise causes a drift of rung coherences, a quantum ratchet with no classical counterpart. Underlying these effects, the noise-averaged dynamics is an interacting (generically non-integrable) Lindbladian that remains analytically tractable. The modes governing late-time relaxation are bound states of the noise-induced interaction and form a band with a point gap, absent both without noise and under postselection, whose winding number fixes the direction of the asymmetry. These effects are within reach of several experimental platforms, including synthetic lattices, superconducting qubits, and optical lattices.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall); Strongly Correlated Electrons (cond-mat.str-el)

summaries.en: The paper shows that dephasing noise, rather than destroying chiral asymmetry in quantum walks, induces topologically robust skewness and edge-localized relaxation modes governed by a non-integrable Lindbladian whose bound-state band has a point-gap winding number fixing the asymmetry direction.
summaries.zh: 该论文表明，退相干噪声非但不会破坏量子行走中的手性不对称性，反而会诱导出拓扑鲁棒性的偏度和边缘局域化的弛豫模式，其由非可积Lindbladian描述，束缚态能带的点隙绕数决定了不对称性的方向。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、量子ウォークにおけるカイラル非対称性を脱位相ノイズが破壊するのではなく、むしろトポロジカルに頑強な歪度と端に局在する緩和モードを誘起し、それが点ギャップの巻き数で非対称性の方向が決まる束縛状態バンドを持つ非可積分リンドブラディアンで記述されることを示す。

title: Krylov meets Fock: Complementary lenses on quantum dynamics
abstract: Quantum dynamics in Krylov space can be represented by a particle hopping on a chain whose sites are the Krylov basis vectors. The goal of this work is to extend this idea to the Fock basis, which in turn allows the description of a generic dynamics in terms of a more general, possibly higher-dimensional lattice. This construction has been dubbed the Fock state lattice (FSL), since its sites are identified with Fock states. To analyze the dynamics on the FSL we introduce various measures of the spread of a state, comparing them among themselves and with their Krylov counterparts. We apply our analysis to two models of light-matter interaction studied in quantum optics: the multi-mode Jaynes-Cummings and the Dicke models. We find that, whenever the FSL is not a chain, the corresponding dynamics provides insights complementary to the Krylov space analysis and, in some instances, greater analytical control. For example, we obtain analytical results for the FSL spread measures of the Dicke model in the thermodynamic limit and determine that their scaling in time detects the superradiant phase transition.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Statistical Mechanics (cond-mat.stat-mech); High Energy Physics - Theory (hep-th)

summaries.en: The paper introduces the Fock state lattice as a complementary framework to Krylov-space methods for quantum dynamics, applying it to multi-mode Jaynes-Cummings and Dicke models and showing that Fock-state-lattice spread measures yield analytical results and detect the superradiant phase transition through their time scaling in the Dicke model's thermodynamic limit.
summaries.zh: 该论文引入了Fock态晶格，作为Krylov空间方法研究量子动力学的补充框架，将其应用于多模Jaynes-Cummings模型和Dicke模型，并表明Fock态晶格的扩展度量可给出解析结果，且在Dicke模型的热力学极限下通过其时间标度检测超辐射相变。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、量子ダイナミクスのKrylov空間解析を補完する枠組みとしてFock状態格子を導入し、多モードJaynes-Cummings模型とDicke模型に適用して、Fock状態格子上の広がり尺度が解析的結果を与え、Dicke模型の熱力学極限においてその時間スケーリングが超放射相転移を検出することを示した。

title: Boosted Entanglement Swapping
abstract: Entanglement swapping entangles photons that never interacted directly. When implemented with linear optics, its success probability is upper bounded by $50\%$, due to the limited efficiency of linear-optical Bell-state measurements. Here, we demonstrate boosted entanglement swapping using an ancilla-assisted linear-optical Bell-state measurement, which raises the theoretical success probability to $62.5\%$ and allows all four Bell states to be identified. We measure an acceptance rate of $p_{\mathrm{a}}^{\mathrm{b}}=(69.39\pm0.39)\%$ with an average fidelity of the swapped states of $\langle F^{\mathrm{b}}\rangle=(76.6\pm1.0)\%$. We implement this protocol using photons at 1550 nm, making it well suited for quantum repeaters, where it could enable more efficient entanglement distribution. Beyond quantum communication, it could also enhance fusion-based quantum computing.

summaries.en: Using an ancilla-assisted linear-optical Bell-state measurement, the authors boost the success probability of entanglement swapping from the 50% linear-optics bound to a theoretical 62.
summaries.zh: 作者利用辅助光子辅助的线性光学贝尔态测量，将纠缠交换的理论成功概率从线性光学的50%上限提升至62.
summaries.ja: 補助光子を用いた線形光学ベル状態測定により、著者らはもつれ交換の理論的成功確率を線形光学の50%の上限から62.

title: Multipartite entanglement swapping with homodyne and single photon detection
abstract: Establishing multipartite entanglement across lossy optical networks remains a central challenge for distributed quantum information processing. Here, we consider a non-Gaussian continuous-variable entanglement-swapping protocol combining a symmetric discrete Fourier transform (DFT) interferometer with photon-number-resolving detection. In the ideal limit, single-photon heralding generates a $W_N$-class state across remote modes, with Fourier symmetry rendering all single-click outcomes equivalent up to local phase corrections. We find that conditional pairwise entanglement can exceed that of conventional Gaussian homodyne swapping in weak-to-moderate squeezing and lossy regimes, remaining nonzero beyond the channel-loss thresholds at which Gaussian pairwise entanglement vanishes. These results demonstrate that combining non-Gaussian measurements with symmetric interferometric mixing can improve both the resilience and operational efficiency of multipartite entanglement distribution in lossy quantum networks.

summaries.en: A non-Gaussian continuous-variable entanglement-swapping protocol combining a symmetric discrete Fourier transform interferometer with photon-number-resolving detection can herald a W_N-class state across remote modes and yield pairwise entanglement that exceeds conventional Gaussian homodyne swapping in weak-to-moderate squeezing and lossy regimes, persisting beyond the channel-loss thresholds where Gaussian pairwise entanglement vanishes.
summaries.zh: 一种将对称离散傅里叶变换干涉仪与光子数分辨探测相结合的非高斯连续变量纠缠交换协议，能够在远程模式间预示出W_N类态，并在弱至中等压缩和损耗情形下产生超过传统高斯零差交换的成对纠缠，且其成对纠缠在信道损耗超过高斯成对纠缠消失的阈值后仍然存在。
summaries.ja: 対称離散フーリエ変換干渉計と光子数分解検出を組み合わせた非ガウス連続変数エンタングルメントスワッピングプロトコルは、遠隔モード間にW_Nクラス状態を heralding でき、弱から中程度のスクイージングおよび損失のある領域で従来のガウスホモダインスワッピングを上回るペアワイズエンタングルメントを生成し、ガウスのペアワイズエンタングルメントが消失するチャネル損失閾値を超えてもなお非零に保たれる。

title: Efficient training of a 128-modes 3D continuously coupled photonic chip via limited quantum resources
abstract: Integrated photonics provides a promising route towards the development of large-scale, stable and low-loss quantum hardware. Existing implementations of universal quantum photonic chips generally rely on architectures consisting of localised interactions between the modes that can be programmed with known algorithms to implement specific operations. Recent advances have shown that interferometers based on 3D continuously coupled waveguide arrays may allow to significantly scale up the number of modes with reduced overhead. However, for this class of devices, optimal strategies to set the controllable parameters and obtain the desired transformation have not been demonstrated generally. In this work, we report the use of a machine learning algorithm driven by quantum data to program the operation of a reconfigurable three-dimensional continuously coupled photonic device comprising 128 modes. We show experimentally the capability of reaching a target unitary matrix, among those achievable by the device, through a limited number of one- and two-photon measurements. Our results demonstrate that this approach results to be effective in the presence of noise and with a limited amount of resources, also allowing to partially compensate imperfections in the experimental setup. This method can thus represent a viable route towards programming large scale integrated photonic devices, unlocking the possibility of controlling photonic systems for which an analytical decomposition is not trivial.

summaries.en: A quantum-data-driven machine learning algorithm was used to program a reconfigurable 128-mode 3D continuously coupled photonic chip, reaching a target unitary matrix through a limited number of one- and two-photon measurements even in the presence of noise and setup imperfections.
summaries.zh: 研究利用由量子数据驱动的机器学习算法来编程一个128模式的三维连续耦合可重构光子器件，通过有限次数单光子和双光子测量即可达到目标酉矩阵，并且在存在噪声和实验装置缺陷的情况下依然有效。
summaries.ja: 量子データに基づく機械学習アルゴリズムを用いて128モードの3次元連続結合フォトニックチップをプログラミングし、限られた回数の単光子・二光子測定によって目標のユニタリ行列に到達できることを、ノイズや実験装置の不完全性がある状況でも実証した。

title: Collectively pumped superradiant laser with coherence scaling beyond the standard quantum limit
abstract: For more than half a century, the standard quantum limit (SQL) was thought to limit the laser coherence $\mathfrak{C}$ -- the number of photons emitted from the laser into the beam in one coherence time -- to a scaling $\Theta(\mu^2)$, where $\mu$ is the mean number of optical-frequency excitations stored inside the laser. However, recently it has been shown [Baker et al., Nat. Phys. 17, 179 (2021)] that the Heisenberg limit -- an achievable ultimate limit set by quantum mechanics for the task of producing a beam with the standard properties of a laser beam -- is $\mathfrak{C}=\Theta(\mu^4)$, a quadratic enhancement. So far, proposals to demonstrate beyond-SQL scaling of $\mathfrak{C}$ have been limited to circuit QED, at microwave frequencies (i.e., a maser). Here, we introduce a class of generalized far-above-threshold (FAT) laser models, obtained by replacing the ordinary bosonic lowering operator $\hat{a}$ by a general lowering operator $\hat{L}$ in the superoperators appearing in the master equation that governs the FAT laser dynamics. We then show that an optical-frequency superradiant laser in the bad-cavity limit, with feedback-controlled collective pumping, realizes one such model, in which $\hat{L}$ is identified with the collective superradiant lowering operator $\hat{J}$. This model can surpass the SQL scaling, with the coherence exhibiting a scaling as large as $\mathfrak{C}= \Theta(\mu^{8/3})$ in the optimal parameter regime. Here, in the bad-cavity limit, $\mu\approx N/2$, where $N$ is the number of superradiant atoms.

summaries.en: A feedback-controlled collectively pumped superradiant optical laser in the bad-cavity limit can surpass the standard quantum limit, achieving coherence scaling as large as Θ(μ^(8/3)) in the optimal parameter regime.
summaries.zh: 在坏腔极限下，采用反馈控制的集体泵浦超辐射光学激光器能够超越标准量子极限，在最优参数区间实现高达Θ(μ^(8/3))的相干性标度。
summaries.ja: バッドキャビティ極限においてフィードバック制御された集団ポンピング超放射光レーザーは標準量子限界を超えることができ、最適パラメータ領域でΘ(μ^(8/3))ものコヒーレンススケーリングを達成する。

title: Helium States in a CAS(2,2) Subspace Inspired by Quantum Photonics
abstract: We present a four-mode Fock-state photonics implementation of the variational quantum deflation (VQD) algorithm to calculate the ground-state and excited-state energies for the neutral helium atom in a CAS(2,2) Subspace. Its CAS(2,2) electronic Hilbert space is encoded into a bosonic Fock-space representation and subsequently optimized using a continuous-variable quantum circuit. The circuit architecture under study is constructed of single-mode phase shifts, beam splitters, and cross-Kerr interactions. The variational circuit is initialized in the Fock state $\ket{1100}$ and its performance is benchmarked against exact diagonalization of the active-space configuration-interaction (CASCI) Hamiltonian. We also extend the method to optimize from the first to three excited states of the helium atom with the aid of the variational quantum deflation $(VQD)$ method in a CAS(2,2). We then investigate the performance of this circuit architecture as a basis for implementing the VQD method. In the ideal noiseless simulation setting, we see that the survival probability of the ground and the excited states within the target $CAS$ subspace is unity, because the total photon number and the photon number in the two spin sectors $\alpha$ and $\beta$ are preserved. We demonstrate that the proposed approach enables the determination of the ground and excited-state energies within the CAS(2,2) electronic Hilbert space using a continuous-variable quantum circuit and the variational quantum deflation ($VQD$) algorithm, while satisfying the orthogonality conditions with negligible errors.

summaries.en: A four-mode continuous-variable photonic circuit using phase shifts, beam splitters, and cross-Kerr interactions, with the variational quantum deflation algorithm, computes the ground- and first three excited-state energies of neutral helium in a CAS(2,2) subspace, matching exact diagonalization while preserving photon number and spin-sector occupations so orthogonality holds with negligible error.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种由相位移动、分束器和交叉克尔相互作用构成的四模连续变量光子线路，结合变分量子紧缩算法，在中性氦原子CAS(2,2)子空间内计算基态与前三激发态能量，结果与精确对角化一致，并因总光子数及α、β自旋区光子数守恒而保持正交性、误差可忽略。
summaries.ja: 位相シフト、ビームスプリッター、クロスKerr相互作用からなる4モード連続変数量子回路と変分量子デフレーション法を用いて、中性ヘリウム原子のCAS(2,2)部分空間における基底状態および第1～第3励起状態のエネルギーを計算し、光子数とα・βスピン部門の光子数が保存されるため直交性を無視できる誤差で満たしつつ、厳密対角化と一致する結果を得た。

title: Secrecy and Covertness Analysis of SWAN-Enabled Uplink EDMA-NOMA Systems
abstract: Environment division multiple access (EDMA) has recently emerged as a promising multiple-access paradigm by exploiting the wireless propagation environment for user separation, while physical-layer security, including secrecy and covert communication, is becoming increasingly important for protecting confidential information and user privacy. Motivated by these considerations, this paper proposes an EDMA-enabled non-orthogonal multiple access for secrecy and covert communications (EDMA-NOMA-SC) framework for uplink wireless systems. In the proposed framework, a segmented-waveguide-enabled pinching antenna system (SWAN) is employed, where a secrecy user and an intermittently active covert user share the same transmission resource through NOMA within each segment, while a malicious warden attempts to eavesdrop on the secrecy transmission and detect the presence of the covert communication. To capture practical operating conditions, distance-dependent blockage, inter-segment interference, in-waveguide attenuation, imperfect channel state information (ipCSI), and imperfect successive interference cancellation (ipSIC) are considered. Semi-analytical frameworks are developed to characterize the secrecy outage probability (SOP), average secrecy capacity (ASC), false alarm probability (FAP), missed detection probability (MDP), detection error probability (DEP), and covert rate (CR), with their accuracy verified through Monte Carlo simulations. Numerical results, including comparisons with conventional and EDMA-based benchmark schemes, show that the proposed framework generally achieves improved secrecy and covert-rate performance owing to reduced user-to-pinching-antenna propagation distances and in-waveguide attenuation. However, excessive segmentation can degrade performance when inter-segment interference outweighs these propagation benefits.

summaries.en: This paper proposes an EDMA-NOMA framework with a segmented-waveguide-enabled pinching antenna system for uplink secrecy and covert communications, deriving semi-analytical expressions for secrecy outage probability, average secrecy capacity, detection error metrics, and covert rate under practical impairments, and showing that it generally improves secrecy and covert-rate performance through reduced propagation distances and in-waveguide attenuation, although excessive segmentation can degrade performance when inter-segment interference dominates.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一种基于分段波导赋能夹持天线系统的EDMA-NOMA框架，用于上行链路保密与隐蔽通信，并在考虑实际损伤的条件下推导了保密中断概率、平均保密容量、检测错误指标和隐蔽速率的半解析表达式，结果表明该框架通过缩短传播距离和波导内衰减总体提升了保密与隐蔽速率性能，但过度分段会在段间干扰超过这些传播增益时导致性能下降。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、分割導波路を用いたピンチングアンテナシステムを備えたEDMA-NOMAフレームワークを上りリンクの秘匿・隠蔽通信のために提案し、実用的な劣化要因を考慮して秘匿中断確率、平均秘匿容量、検出誤り指標、隠蔽レートの半解析式を導出し、伝搬距離の短縮と導波路内減衰により概して秘匿性能と隠蔽レート性能が向上するものの、過度な分割はセグメント間干渉がこれらの伝搬利得を上回る場合に性能を劣化させ得ることを示した。

title: Perturbation-Based Reconstruction of Depth-Resolved OCT Attenuation without Requiring a Fully Decayed Signal Tail
abstract: Depth-resolved attenuation in optical coherence tomography (OCT) can provide quantitative optical contrast beyond structural imaging. However, conventional reconstruction methods can be biased when the OCT signal does not fully decay within the imaging range or when the distal signal tail is dominated by noise or residual reflections from distal sample or support interfaces. Here, we present a perturbation-based Beer-Lambert framework that combines a zeroth-order exponential estimate with a first-order correction, reducing reliance on the unreliable distal signal tail below the current depth. Numerical A-line simulations, Monte Carlo modeling, multilayer silicone-dye-TiO2 phantoms, and ex vivo bovine retina experiments were used to evaluate the method under finite-depth and heterogeneous imaging conditions. The numerical A-line tests showed reduced depth-dependent error against prescribed attenuation profiles; the Monte Carlo comparisons showed less distal drift relative to model-defined benchmarks, while the phantom profiles were compared with separately acquired single-layer OCT calibration values. In a Monte Carlo component test that withheld vessel-mask and vessel-boundary information from reconstruction and used that information only for post hoc evaluation, the first-order correction recovered 61% of the segmentation-informed target vessel contrast and reduced vessel ROI mean absolute error by 65% relative to the fixed zeroth-order baseline. These results suggest that perturbation-based reconstruction may provide a practical approach for depth-resolved reconstruction of effective OCT attenuation when the fully decayed A-line condition is not satisfied.

summaries.en: A perturbation-based Beer-Lambert reconstruction combining a zeroth-order exponential estimate with a first-order correction enables depth-resolved OCT attenuation imaging with reduced bias when the signal tail is not fully decayed or is dominated by noise, as validated by simulations, Monte Carlo modeling, phantoms, and ex vivo bovine retina experiments.
summaries.zh: 一种基于微扰的Beer-Lambert重建方法将零阶指数估计与一阶校正相结合，在OCT信号尾部未完全衰减或被噪声主导时可减少偏差地实现深度分辨的OCT衰减成像，并已通过数值仿真、蒙特卡罗建模、体模及离体牛视网膜实验验证。
summaries.ja: ゼロ次指数推定と一次補正を組み合わせた摂動ベースのBeer-Lambert再構成法は、OCT信号の裾が十分に減衰しない場合やノイズに支配される場合でもバイアスを低減して深さ分解OCT減衰イメージングを可能にし、数値シミュレーション、モンテカルロモデリング、ファントム、および摘出ウシ網膜実験で検証された。

title: SIM-Enabled Wave-Domain Processing in MIMO-OFDM Receivers: Architecture, Modeling, and Validation
abstract: This paper develops a wave-domain linear receiver for wideband MIMO-OFDM, where the main high-dimensional linear processing conventionally performed after sampling is physically shifted to propagation through stacked intelligent metasurfaces (SIMs). The proposed receiver transforms receive-port waveforms into OFDM-domain symbols through three cascaded SIM-enabled functional sections. The first section, SIM_1, performs channel-memory processing and channel shortening in an energy-concentration sense, suppressing the out-of-cyclic-prefix (CP) effective tail before OFDM analysis. SIM_2 realizes CP removal and discrete Fourier transform (DFT) analysis as cyclic-windowed OFDM matched filtering by exploiting useful-window memory and analytical Fourier phase coding. SIM_3 implements residual virtual-subcarrier MIMO linear detection, completing the wave-domain linear receive chain up to symbol slicing. Synchronization, control, slicing, and decoding remain digital, while the dominant linear receive operations are moved to the wave domain. A staged configuration framework is developed: the numerology-dependent OFDM analyzer is compiled offline, whereas the channel-dependent memory processor and detector are configured over the coherence time using architecture-aware learning-assisted control. Numerical results validate both functional replacement and link performance, confirming nearly lossless replacement under CP-sufficient MIMO-OFDM conditions, with robustness to residual timing offsets and effective channel-delay-profile perturbations. Substantial gains under CP-insufficient channels are also demonstrated by suppressing out-of-CP leakage before OFDM analysis.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a wave-domain linear receiver for wideband MIMO-OFDM in which channel-memory processing and shortening, CP removal and DFT analysis, and residual virtual-subcarrier MIMO detection are implemented through cascaded stacked intelligent metasurfaces (SIM_1, SIM_2, SIM_3), while synchronization, control, slicing, and decoding remain digital, validating near-lossless functional replacement under CP-sufficient conditions, robustness to residual timing offsets and channel-delay-profile perturbations, and substantial gains under CP-insufficient channels.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种面向宽带MIMO-OFDM的波域线性接收机，通过级联的堆叠智能超表面（SIM_1、SIM_2、SIM_3）将信道记忆处理与信道缩短、CP去除与DFT分析以及残余虚拟子载波MIMO检测迁移至波域实现，而同步、控制、符号判决与解码仍保持数字处理，数值结果验证了在CP充分条件下近乎无损的功能替换、对残余定时偏移与信道时延分布扰动的鲁棒性，以及CP不足信道下抑制CP外泄漏带来的显著增益。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、広帯域MIMO-OFDM向けの波動領域線形受信機を提案し、チャネルメモリ処理とチャネル短縮、CP除去とDFT解析、残余仮想サブキャリアMIMO検出を縦続接続したスタック型インテリジェントメタサーフェス（SIM_1、SIM_2、SIM_3）により波動領域で実現する一方、同期・制御・スライシング・復号はディジタルに留め、CP十分条件下でのほぼ無損失な機能置換、残留タイミングオフセットとチャネル遅延プロファイル摂動へのロバスト性、およびCP不足チャネル下でのCP外リーク抑圧による大幅な利得を数値結果により検証している。

title: Vertical Segmented Waveguide-Enabled Pinching Antenna (V-SWAN)-Assisted EDMA-NOMA Integrated Sensing and Communication Systems
abstract: This paper proposes a vertical segmented waveguide-enabled pinching antenna (V-SWAN)-assisted downlink non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA)-integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) environmental division multiple access (EDMA) framework for simultaneously supporting multi-user communication and target sensing. In the proposed framework, multiple pinching antennas (PAs) are deployed along a segmented vertical dielectric waveguide to serve communication users (CUs), aerial users (AUs), and sensing target (ST). CUs are distributed on the ground, whereas AUs and ST are above the ground, where line-of-sight (LoS) and non-line-of-sight (NLoS) propagation conditions coexist. In particular, SWAN provides an effective platform for realizing EDMA by reducing the effective propagation distance and in-waveguide attenuation, thereby suppressing co-channel interference and enabling efficient multi-user transmission. The communication and sensing model are formulated, followed by the corresponding SINR expressions. We formulate the statistical characterizations for the combination of LoS and NLoS propagation for CUs, and LoS propagation for AUs and sensing channels for generalized multi-user, multi-PA scenarios. Based on these statistical characterizations, the segment outage and sensing outage probabilities are derived and evaluated for the generalized framework. The asymptotic evaluation is also done at a high transmit signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) to gain further insights. The results show that the proposed framework outperforms the conventional H-SWAN and single vertical pinching antenna system (V-PASS) in terms of segment outage probability, sensing outage probability, and segment sum rate. Monte Carlo simulation results closely match the analytical results, validating the accuracy of the derived expressions.

summaries.en: This paper proposes a vertical segmented waveguide-enabled pinching antenna (V-SWAN)-assisted downlink NOMA-ISAC EDMA framework that reduces effective propagation distance and in-waveguide attenuation to suppress co-channel interference while simultaneously serving ground and aerial users and sensing a target, with derived segment and sensing outage probabilities and asymptotic analyses showing it outperforms conventional H-SWAN and single vertical pinching antenna systems.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一种由垂直分段波导赋能夹持天线（V-SWAN）辅助的下行NOMA-ISAC EDMA框架，通过缩短有效传播距离并降低波导内衰减来抑制同信道干扰，从而同时服务地面用户、空中用户并感知目标，推导了分段中断概率与感知中断概率及高信噪比渐近分析，结果表明该框架在分段中断概率、感知中断概率和分段和速率方面优于传统H-SWAN和单垂直夹持天线系统。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、垂直分割導波路を用いたピンチングアンテナ（V-SWAN）支援の下りリンクNOMA-ISAC EDMAフレームワークを提案し、実効伝搬距離と導波路内減衰を低減することで同一チャネル干渉を抑圧しながら地上・空中ユーザへの通信と目標センシングを同時に実現し、セグメント停止確率とセンシング停止確率の導出および高SNR漸近解析により、従来のH-SWANや単一垂直ピンチングアンテナシステムより優れることを示した。

title: Continuous Wideband Multicarrier Rydberg Atomic Quantum Receiver
abstract: This paper investigates continuous wideband orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) reception using an auxiliary (AUX)-assisted five-level Rydberg atomic quantum receiver (RAQR) with a single microwave local oscillator (LO), without requiring additional atomic reception transitions or LO frequency combs. By exploiting Floquet theory, the proposed framework characterizes the dynamic atomic response at finite signal-LO detunings without relying on a quasi-static Taylor expansion around the LO operating point. Specifically, closed-form radio-frequency (RF)-to-electrical conversion expressions are derived from the Lindblad master equation under weak-probe and weak-signal approximations. Building on these expressions, an equivalent multicarrier communication model is established, revealing the inherent frequency selectivity of the atomic response and the resulting subcarrier-dependent amplitude and phase distortions. RAQR-aware zero-forcing (ZF) equalization is developed to enable reliable OFDM reception. Furthermore, analytical results reveal how LO and AUX driving influence the atomic response through dressed-state splitting and energy-level shifts. An upper bound on the LO-referenced half-power span is derived, and an approximately $18$-dB reduction in center-response power per bandwidth doubling is established in the AUX-free strong-LO regime. Simulation results validate the analytical response model and reveal pronounced subcarrier-dependent amplitude and phase variations across over $10$~MHz, highlighting the potential of RAQRs as wideband receiving front ends for future wireless communications.

summaries.en: This paper develops a Floquet-theory-based framework for continuous wideband OFDM reception using an auxiliary-assisted five-level Rydberg atomic quantum receiver with a single microwave local oscillator, deriving closed-form RF-to-electrical conversion expressions, an equivalent multicarrier communication model, and RAQR-aware zero-forcing equalization that together reveal the atomic response's frequency selectivity and enable reliable wideband reception over 10 MHz.
summaries.zh: 本文基于Floquet理论，提出了一种仅使用单一微波本振的辅助五能级里德堡原子量子接收机框架，用于连续宽带OFDM接收，推导了闭式射频到电转换表达式并建立了等效多载波通信模型与RAQR感知的迫零均衡，揭示了原子响应的频率选择性，并实现了超过10 MHz的可靠宽带接收。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、単一のマイクロ波局部発振器を用いた補助支援型五準位リュードベリ原子量子受信機による連続広帯域OFDM受信のためにFloquet理論に基づく枠組みを構築し、閉形式のRF-電気変換式、等価マルチキャリア通信モデル、およびRAQR対応ゼロフォーシング等化を導出して、原子応答の周波数選択性を明らかにするとともに10 MHz超の信頼性の高い広帯域受信を実現する。
